units: <cite ref="Sotah 45b:14">Sot. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>רישא דנ׳ ונפיל</he> it was the head (of the murdered man) that flew off and fell (at a distance from the body).
<cite ref="Nedarim 16a:9">Ned. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה נ׳ מן וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. only <he>נ׳</he>) flew off from, i.e. rejected the reason given by A.
